applicable_sections: section 12 K1/K2 retrieval and untrusted-text boundary

root_cause: The prior A3 service sealed snapshots with the superseded v2.2 ArtifactEnvelope fields and delegated canonical K1/K2 selection to knowledge_flow. That made the frozen v3.0 envelope invalid and left a second selection implementation capable of becoming a competing authority.

alternatives_considered.option: Restore v2.2 ArtifactEnvelope fields or compatibility aliases in the v3 domain.
alternatives_considered.reason: It would let the superseded contract explain the frozen v3.0 domain and create duplicate canonical authority.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep knowledge_flow's old selection algorithm as a fallback for historical callers.
alternatives_considered.reason: A fallback would violate the single K1/K2 implementation invariant; the historical API must delegate to the service-owned deterministic selector.

alternatives_considered.option: Treat raw evidence or knowledge-card claims as trusted prompt content after a textual scan.
alternatives_considered.reason: Raw knowledge remains untrusted input under v3.0; detected security events quarantine the candidate and only screened canonical capsules may reach the Director view.

repair: Moved the sole deterministic K1/K2 candidate selection into services.knowledge_retriever, including eligibility, scope, budget, deduplication, conflict exposure, security quarantine, selected-record accounting, and unselected exclusion reasons.

Changed the canonical service to construct the frozen ArtifactEnvelope contract: artifact type, canonical payload hash, deterministic producer stage, parent artifact IDs, source provenance, knowledge snapshot digest, and UTC creation time.

Deleted the retired selection body from knowledge_flow. Its public historical packet API is an archive adapter that delegates to the service selector and cannot mint a canonical KnowledgeSnapshot or ArtifactEnvelope.
Kept conflicts as explicit records requiring a Director decision and excluded conflict candidates from automatic creative selection.
Preserved the evidence-and-human promotion gate and added no provider, Director runtime, media, production-entry, or production-switch change.

checks.name: single_k1_k2_implementation
checks.evidence: Canonical retrieval never calls knowledge_flow.retrieve_for_diagnosis; the historical API delegates to retrieve_legacy_compatibility, and the retired selection body is absent.

checks.name: replayable_snapshot
checks.evidence: The service returns a v3 ArtifactEnvelope containing one KnowledgeSnapshot; replay validates the immutable canonical payload digest without searching the catalog.

checks.name: untrusted_text_isolation
checks.evidence: Raw source text and unsafe claims are scanned as untrusted input, quarantined, and represented only by safe event metadata/digests outside the Director decision view.

checks.name: director_conflict_ownership
checks.evidence: Conflict records require a Director decision and their option cards are never automatically selected by retrieval.

checks.name: evidence_gated_promotion
checks.evidence: The A3 promotion tests retain the structured evidence, independent verification, and human-approval requirements before a knowledge candidate may be promoted.

checks.name: unselected_knowledge_excluded
checks.evidence: Every catalog candidate is recorded as selected or excluded with a deterministic reason; only selected screened capsules are emitted in the Director decision view.
